resources.string: Motor: amplitude control supported — cleanest 128 Hz envelope.
Motor: on/off only (no amplitude control). 128 Hz envelope produced by pulsing.
This device has no vibration motor.

For research/educational use only. This is NOT a certified medical device. Phone motors cannot be commanded to an exact mechanical frequency: the app pulses the motor 128 times per second to approximate a 128 Hz stimulus. Actual perceived frequency depends on the device\'s actuator. Do not use for diagnosis.
